frase_inicial: Timothy and Melanie: your score is 60 today, and there is a clear way to raise it together.

tarjetas.frente: The high-rate credit card is the first thing dragging your score.
tarjetas.reverso: Carrying that balance costs you most. Using part of the cash you already have to cut it stops interest bleeding and immediately removes the main limit the plan flags.
tarjetas.detalle: Pay $6,800 on the 18% card from cash to reduce revolving exposure; current card balance $18,000; leaves $11,200 on the card after move.

tarjetas.frente: Life insurance for both of you is the other gate the plan shows open.
tarjetas.reverso: With two young kids depending on both incomes, increasing life cover protects Liam and Josh from losing years of income. The plan treats this as a separate step after the card fix.
tarjetas.detalle: Add $235,000 of life cover to reach $485,000 total; after card paydown life cover must reach $491,800 to clear the mortality cap.

tarjetas.frente: You have more cash than the emergency reserve—this is both a strength and a choice.
tarjetas.reverso: That spare cash can pay debt, buy protection, or start college saving. Each choice changes what else you can do later, so pick the order you both prefer.
tarjetas.detalle: Accessible cash $150,800; cash above reserve and near-term goals $60,222.50.

tarjetas.frente: College saving for Liam and Josh is unfunded and small to fix monthly.
tarjetas.reverso: Nothing is in the college accounts yet, so you can start regular saving now. It competes with debt payoff and protection, so decide which comes first.
tarjetas.detalle: Education gap $113,508.60; extra yearly saving needed first year $4,609.22.

tarjetas.frente: You disagree on risk in practice; review your investment mix together.
tarjetas.reverso: Timothy leans growth and Melanie moderate, while your long-term accounts run high in stocks. Agreeing how much swing you can accept will keep both of you sleeping easier.
tarjetas.detalle: Invested savings $210,000; portfolio about 77% stocks versus a 60% moderate target.

siguiente_paso.razon: This is the move the plan marks first: it removes the high-cost drag and raises your published score. It uses cash you already hold and leaves your emergency reserve intact.
pasos: Sit together by your cash account and confirm the available balance shown in your statements.
